name: LiveNX
description_en:
LiveNX monitors network devices and analyzes traffic through a server with optional distributed collectors. The reviewed 25.3.0 guide separates deployment architecture, license acquisition, SNMP discovery, interface admission and report queries. The legacy documentation root redirects to a BlueCat portal containing specifically named LiveNX guides.

A license obtained from a cloud portal is not the same as hosted monitoring infrastructure. Likewise, discovering a device and selecting its interfaces do not prove every desired flow source or application classification is present. Validate a small authorized network segment and expected report scope before broad deployment.
description_zh:
LiveNX 通过服务器及可选分布采集器监控网络设备、分析流量。实读 25.3.0 指南区分部署架构、许可取得、SNMP 发现、接口纳管和报告查询。旧文档根站跳到 BlueCat 门户，其中明确列 LiveNX 指南。

从云门户取得许可不等于托管监控基础设施。发现设备并选择接口，也不证明所需流来源或应用分类全部存在。扩大部署前，应验证小型获准网段和预期报告范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Larger deployments use LiveNX Nodes that aggregate to a server.
core_features.explanation_zh: 较大部署使用汇聚至服务器的 LiveNX Node。

core_features.explanation_en: Discover devices, then explicitly choose interfaces to add.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发现设备后，明确选择需纳入的接口。

core_features.explanation_en: Query application flow by device, site, interface and time period.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按设备、站点、接口及时间查询应用流。

en: Discover one authorized device and verify only its selected interfaces.
Compare a known traffic interval with a scoped application-flow report.
zh: 发现一台获准设备并验证所选接口。
将已知流量时段与限定范围的应用流报告比较。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Plan observation topology, a licensed test installation and read-only SNMP access.
steps.zh: 规划观察拓扑、有许可测试安装及只读 SNMP 访问。

steps.en: Select one device/interfaces, inspect report scope and confirm the actual commercial offer before expansion.
steps.zh: 选择单设备／接口、检查报告范围，扩大前确认实际商业方案。

items.en: Discovered inventory does not prove all interfaces or flow sources were admitted.
items.zh: 发现清单不证明全部接口或流来源已纳入。

items.en: License-portal access is not evidence of hosted infrastructure or a sustained-free LiveNX plan.
items.zh: 许可门户访问不证明托管基础设施或长期免费 LiveNX 方案。

pricing.summary_en: No current complete LiveNX fee/free-license offer was established. The quote form and trial-license portal instructions are not price confirmation; LiveAssurance is a different product. Pricing remains not_verified/unknown, with actual devices/interfaces, collectors, license term, trial scope, support and quote still to verify.
pricing.summary_zh: 未确认当前完整 LiveNX 费用／免费许可方案。询价表及试用许可门户说明不是价格确认，LiveAssurance 属不同产品。价格保持 not_verified／unknown，真实设备／接口、采集器、许可期限、试用、支持及报价待核。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.title_zh: 选择单服务器或分布采集
sections.en: The 25.3.0 architecture guide uses a single server for small deployments/proofs of concept and distributed LiveNX Nodes for larger multi-site environments. Nodes aggregate to the server, with the Operations Dashboard for day-to-day visibility. Map the intended observation sites and server connectivity before selecting topology; this guide does not prove an automatic HA or disaster-recovery guarantee.
sections.zh: 25.3.0 架构指南将单服务器用于小部署／概念验证，多站点较大环境使用分布 LiveNX Node 汇聚至服务器，日常通过 Operations Dashboard 查看。选拓扑前应绘制观察站点和服务器连接，指南不证明自动 HA 或灾备保证。

sections.title_zh: 有意识地准备只读 SNMP 访问
sections.en: The SNMP guide uses read-only community strings or SNMPv3 credentials to discover devices and poll hostname, CPU, memory and interface statistics. Confirm device configuration and network reachability before discovery. A successful ping alone does not demonstrate that the SNMP data or intended flow records are available. No credential or network scan was used here.
sections.zh: SNMP 指南使用只读 community string 或 SNMPv3 凭据发现设备并轮询主机名、CPU、内存、接口统计。发现前应确认设备配置和可达性，ping 成功不证明 SNMP 或所需流记录可用。本次未使用凭据或扫描网络。

sections.title_en: Discovery and interface admission are separate
sections.en: The guide enters an IP/range and SNMP settings for discovery, selects a discovered device, then chooses interfaces and applies the selection. Inspect those selections when a device appears in inventory but expected interface data is absent. Use one known test device rather than assuming an entire discovered range has been admitted or completely configured.
sections.zh: 指南先输入 IP／范围及 SNMP 设置发现，选择设备后再选接口并 Apply。设备已在清单却缺预期接口数据时，应检查这些选择。应先用一台已知测试设备，不能假定整个发现范围都已纳管或完整配置。

sections.title_en: Compare classified applications with known traffic
sections.title_zh: 用已知流量比较应用分类
sections.en: Application Flow reports classify traffic by application/protocol and support device, site, interface and time scopes. The guide uses them to identify top inbound/outbound applications and investigate unusual usage. Compare the chosen scope and observed traffic with a known fixture; no classification-accuracy, full-packet capture or every-device coverage guarantee was independently established.
sections.zh: Application Flow 报告按应用／协议分类，并可选设备、站点、接口及时间，指南用于查看进出主要应用和异常用量。应将范围及观察流量与已知样本比较；未独立证明分类准确率、完整抓包或全部设备覆盖。

sections.title_en: Portal licensing and commercial terms are different
sections.title_zh: 门户许可与商业条款分开
sections.en: The 25.3.0 license guide requires a registered portal account to retrieve LiveNX licenses and mentions credentials issued for a trial cloud license. It does not establish the current trial allocation or price. The current quote route likewise has no verified fee schedule. Do not apply the separate LiveAssurance freemium offer to LiveNX or infer hosted infrastructure from the word cloud.
sections.zh: 25.3.0 许可指南要求已注册门户账户取得 LiveNX 许可，并提及试用云许可凭据，但未证明当前试用额度或价格。当前询价入口也无已核费用表。不能将独立 LiveAssurance freemium 套到 LiveNX，也不能因 cloud 一词推断托管基础设施。
